mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( difficulty.score + CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_mission_info previous_assignment WHERE previous_assignment.user_id = assignment.user_id AND previous_assignment.assign_date = DATE_SUB(assignment.assign_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND previous_assignment.result = 'SUCCESS' ) THEN 5 ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment JOIN tbl_mission_difficulty difficulty ON difficulty.id = assignment.difficulty_id WHERE assignment.user_id = #{userId} AND assignment.assign_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND assignment.result = 'SUCCESS'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_monthly_ranking (user_id, `year_month`, total_score, ranking, ratio, monthly_longest_streak) VALUES (#{userId}, #{yearMonth}, #{totalScore}, 0, 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_score = #{totalScore}
mapper.sql: SELECT ranking.user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.social_name) AS nickname, u.profile_image_key, ranking.total_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ranking.total_score DESC, ranking.user_id ASC ) AS `rank` FROM tbl_monthly_ranking ranking JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = ranking.user_id WHERE ranking.`year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT ranked.user_id, ranked.nickname, ranked.profile_image_key, ranked.total_score, ranked.`rank` FROM () ranked WHERE ranked.`rank` <= #{limit} ORDER BY ranked.`rank`
SELECT ranked.user_id, ranked.nickname, ranked.profile_image_key, ranked.total_score, ranked.`rank` FROM () ranked WHERE ranked.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_monthly_ranking ranking JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = ranking.user_id WHERE ranking.`year_month` = #{yearMonth} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT DISTINCT `year_month` FROM tbl_monthly_ranking ORDER BY `year_month` DESC
